note: Step 0 rules for `agr scene prepare` (Revit FBX). Order: `rules` (Revit family/type name, first match wins), then `material_rules` (material vocabulary taken from max-viz weltbau_layers_default.txt), then nothing -> UNCLASSIFIED = layer 00_РЕШИТЬ_ЧЕЛОВЕКУ (never guessed). A rule gives a fixed `layer` or a `by_place` map over the four places vs the envelope: inside / face (centroid < face_m from the footprint boundary) / roof (above the local roof) / out. `decide: true` sends a matched generic family to 00 with its reason. Optional rule keys: `min_z0_above_base_m` (the rule applies only when the object's bottom is at least that high above the envelope base, else the next rule is tried), `below_parapet` (layer used instead of by_place.roof when the object's top is <= the parapet top of the roof it stands on; parapet = highest envelope wall touching that roof outline, at most envelope.parapet_max_m above it), `flag` {key, ru, places?} (marks the matched objects on the review sheet and in census.md). New rules learnt from Artem's accepted split go here, not into code.

envelope.position_note: Keep footprint facade and uncovered roof hits. Recover setbacks from closed envelope rings at the object's centre height. A matching exterior wall whose hull intersects a level ring can reach the facade even when its centre is >= face_m away.
